scenicChapters.title: Slovenia Vrsic Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 105 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

places-skocjan-caves-keutschacher-see-2.story: 416 km from Divača to Divača, about 7 h 10 of riding. On the way it passes Idrijska Bela - Belca Water Barrier on the, Longobards in Italy. Places of the Power, Keutschacher See and back through Longobards in Italy. Places of the Power. The highest point is about 1,000 m. It crosses Slovenia, Italy and Austria - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
